a.text: The airline's first tourist-orientated flight commenced.

b.text: The airline's first tourist-oriented flight commenced, a pilgrimage flight to the Holy Land.

a.text: Deutsche Flugdienst took over its rival Condor-Luftreederei.

b.text: The airline adopted Condor Flugdienst GmbH as its operating name.

a.text: Condor launched its first long-haul flights.

b.text: The company launched its first long-haul flights.

a.text: It was announced that the Polish Aviation Group would acquire Condor.

b.text: Condor announced that PGL Polish Aviation Group would be buying Condor.
